reviews.title: Love this app! Would love one feature
reviews.text:
I’ve used this app for years and love it, I’ve used the free and paid version and I love how the free version doesn’t block you from using the fundamental functionality of the app. 

However, I wish there was a setting to say whether I’m trying to quit a habit or do it more frequently, instead of congratulating me when it’s been 14 days since I last flossed. 

I use this app to help with my ADHD-related time blindness to tell me how long it has been since I last washed the sheets, cleaned the litter, ordered a refill, flossed, or had a particular symptom. 

I love this app because other habit trackers force reminders on you or don’t tell you how long it’s been since you last performed a habit. But it would be a GOAT if it wasn’t only geared towards trying to quit smoking.

reviews.title: Simple and Meaningful
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Days Since for probably 10–12 years now, and I’ve never even needed the premium version. That alone says a lot about how useful this app has been to me.

I use it to keep track of important dates and milestones in my life, especially those connected to bad habits. Some dates are more than just numbers on a calendar. Being able to open an app and see exactly how much time has passed since giving up something that at one time made my life unmanageable can be a powerful reminder of where you’ve been and how far you’ve come.

What I appreciate most is how simple and dependable Days Since has remained. It does exactly what I need it to do without constantly pestering me, pushing upgrades, or getting in the way.

After all these years, they finally asked me to leave a review. I figured they earned one.

Thank you to the team behind Days Since for creating something simple that has quietly been part of my life for a very long time.

reviews.title: Good app!
reviews.text:
I really like the app! I use the free version, so I’m not sure what I’m missing out on compared to the paid version, but it does everything I need it to do.

My only complaint is that there’s no way to correct your stats if you forget to reset your tracker. The last time I quit smoking, I eventually started again but didn’t reset my tracker until I quit again. Because of that, my stats say my longest streak was 273 days, when my actual longest streak is my current, 96 days.

It’s definitely not a big deal, but it gives me that tiny little twinge in my brain every time I see the incorrect number. 😆 I wish there were a way to manually correct it.

Other than that, I really enjoy the app. It’s fun and motivating to see how far you’ve come, and being able to look at my progress genuinely helps me keep pushing!

reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: Days since is a tool for any person who wants to be more present in their life. It is for habit builders, habit breakers, and people who wish to live life to the fullest. You are a product of your habits, and with a tool that is this easy to use, elegant, simple, no frills, and free, these habits begin to help you, not hurt you. Thank you.
